primer: Engineers India Limited (ENGINERSIN) is a debt-free Navratna engineering and EPC firm. It designed 20 of India's 23 refineries and holds a record ₹20,421 Cr order book, 75% in Consultancy. At ₹296.55 (18.6x TTM P/E), our corrected FY28E EPS of ₹16.95 at 21.0x P/E gives a ₹356 base target (+20.0%). That yields only 1.30:1 asymmetry at CMP (1.13:1 at ₹300.40) against a ₹251.01 stop, below our 1.50:1 hurdle. We therefore assign REJECTED (VALUATION) and keep 100% in cash until price pulls back to ₹265–₹275 or H2 FY27 earnings beat.
